system.led.note: LED not mounted on prototype — PA15 ODR toggles correctly via SWD readback

system.delay.note: SYSCLK measured against 1000 USB SOFs at every level, within 0.15 % (tests/hw-h5-bringup, 2026-09-26)

system.tick.note: SysTick from SYSCLK_HZ, which now matches the measured SYSCLK (tests/hw-h5-bringup, 2026-09-26)

system.uid.note: USB serial number = the 96-bit UID read with the ICACHE off (tests/hw-h5-bringup, 2026-09-26)

system.recovery.note: Strike words at the top of SRAM (hal_dfu.h); the escalation itself is not bench-run. The ROM entry it ends in works (conn.dfu, BOOT0 low)

clocks.hsi.note: HSIDIV set by ll_rcc_h5_clock_config (it reset to /2): medium measured 64.08 MHz (tests/hw-h5-bringup, 2026-09-26)

clocks.csi.note: CSI itself works; coregen's 'low' now runs HSI/4 (16 MHz) instead, as USB needs APB2 >= 12 MHz

clocks.pll.note: high 128.17 MHz, max 248.35 MHz measured; flash wait states + WRHIGHFREQ per RM0481 Table 45 read back (tests/hw-h5-bringup, 2026-09-26)

gpio.exti.note: Port select now in EXTI_EXTICRx (was a reserved SBS offset); read back right on a clean boot (tests/hw-h5-bringup, 2026-09-26); pin interrupt not benched

uart.polling.note: Baud rates from SYSCLK_HZ, which now matches the real clock; not benched

i2c.std.note: Timing now at the real clock; I2C3 clock bit fixed (APB3ENR bit 7), clock on and TIMINGR read back on a clean boot (tests/hw-h5-bringup, 2026-09-26); no bus benched

i2c.fast.note: Timing now at the real clock; no bus benched

i2c.target.note: I2C1 only; vector table fixed (RM0481 Table 147); not benched

spi.master.note: Bench-verified 2026-09-26 on Core.ST.H5 (tests/hw-spi-loopback config-h5.json, SPI1 on pads 9/8/3, pad 8 -> pad 3 strap, 4 runs PASS): all four modes, 1-4096 B, bounded timeouts, CS framing; 250 kHz to 32 MHz SCK (per_ck 64 MHz / 2), 3.99 MB/s polled. The old stall: the SPI v2 master clocks its serial side from the SCK pin (RM0481 §52.4.1), and SCK was left in analog mode (reset state, §13.3.1), whose input reads 0 (§13.3.12); coregen sets the pin to AF5. SPI3 has no SCK pad on this Core; with PB3 (AF6) it transfers too (tests/hw-h5-bringup).

spi.dma.note: Bench-verified 2026-09-26 on Core.ST.H5 (tests/hw-spi-loopback config-h5.json): GPDMA1 CH6/CH7 (REQSEL spi1 6/7, spi3 10/11, RM0481 Table 136), blocking and async with callback, 3.99 MB/s at 32 MHz SCK; SPI3 DMA with SCK on PB3 in tests/hw-h5-bringup.

timer.tick.note: Vector table fixed, TIM6/TIM7 get their vectors. TIM1 1 kHz update: 1002 ticks over 1000 USB SOFs at 248 MHz (tests/hw-h5-bringup, 2026-09-26, BOOT0 low; after a BOOT0-high ROM leave GTZC1_TZSC blocks the TIM1 clock until a reset)

timer.pwm.note: Timer clock now the real clock; not benched

timer.capture.note: Timer clock now the real clock; not benched

adc.mv.note: VREFINT is channel 17, the calibration word is read 16-bit with the ICACHE off: VDDA 3293-3297 mV calibrated (tests/hw-h5-bringup, 2026-09-26, BOOT0 low)

adc.dma.note: Circular: the GPDMA has no circular bit, so the ring is one linked-list item that links to itself (RM0481 §16.4.7). Bench 2026-09-26 (tests/hw-h5-bringup, VREFINT, 32-sample ring): 5931 half/full callbacks in 1 s, evenly spread, none after hal_adc_stop_dma; samples 1515-1521 (VREFINT_CAL 1515).

adc.trigger.note: Register path is generic (CFGR1 EXTSEL/EXTEN), but only the Core.ST.L0 trigger source constants are defined (LL_ADC_L0_TRG_*, RM0377 Table 58). Other families need a raw encoding from their own reference manual.

coregen.spi.note: config-h5.json in tests/hw-spi-loopback: pads 9/8/3 to AF5, pad 2 as a GPIO chip select, bench PASS 2026-09-26

power.stop.note: Stop 0 + RTC wake-up worked before the audit. The H5 keeps the old sleep code: no watchdog-safe chunking (a sleep longer than the watchdog timeout resets the chip), and millis resets after Stop. Pending the H5 fix session (portal task #282)

power.rtc_wake.note: LSI RTC wake-up from Stop 0 works, but the wake-up timer is set inside RTC init mode, which drags the calendar back by up to 1 s per core_stop_for. Pending the H5 fix session (portal task #282)

power.rtc_alarm.note: LL+Core Alarm A implemented. Tested in tests/val-backup-rng-alarm (Core.ST.H5)

power.backup.note: 32 backup registers (BKP0-31) at TAMP+0x100. Tested in tests/val-backup-rng-alarm (Core.ST.H5)

security.rng.note: ll_rng conditioning-reset + enable for the H523; builds in tests/val-backup-rng-alarm, not bench-run

security.aes.note: The STM32H523 has no AES engine (DS14540); AES is on the H533

security.pka.note: The STM32H523 has a PKA (ECDSA signature verification, DS14540); no driver yet

conn.usb_cdc.note: tiles#285 behavior ported; tests/hw-usb-robust 7/7 (early, serial, zlp, burst, dtr, stall) with BOOT0 high and with BOOT0 low across a real reset; CRS trims HSI48 from SOF (SYNCOK), 2026-09-26

conn.usb_hid.note: HID path rewritten with the #285 port (report timeout, no blocking in interrupts); not re-benched

conn.dfu.note: make flash-dfu (1200-baud touch, ROM DFU, download, leave): BOOT0 high resets into the ROM; BOOT0 low jumps to the ROM (0x0BF97000) from core_init before the clocks, 2026-09-26

conn.serial_update.note: make flash-serial (flasher_h5.c): 5 in a row hands-free with BOOT0 high (28 KB in 0.2-0.5 s), a 336 KB image across both banks, and 3 in a row with BOOT0 low, 2026-09-26. An interrupted update needs BOOT0 high to recover

nvm.flash_emu.note: 1 KB in the flash high-cycle data area (EDATA, 100k cycles): bank 2 sectors 30-31, read at 0x09015000, written 16 bits at a time. core_init() switches the area on at a Core's first boot (FLASH_EDATA2R only, then one reset); bench 2026-09-26: EDATA2R_CUR 0x00000000 -> 0x00008001, every other option register unchanged, later boots write nothing. tests/hw-nvm-flash (config-h5.json) PASS twice: read-back, compactions, reset, 24 power-loss resets (0 garbage), survives flash-serial and flash-dfu of another image. tests/host-nvm-sim runs the H5 geometry with a cut at each 16-bit program (76,137 runs).

nvm.otp.note: The STM32H523 has an OTP area; core_otp does not map it yet (size 0, reads return an error)
